title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student provides the correct final answer for the thickness of the film.

title: Optical Path Difference
description: Important Criteria: The student correctly identifies the relationship between optical path difference and thickness of the film.

title: Fringe Shift Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student accurately calculates the change in fringe order due to the film insertion.

title: Use of Index of Refraction
description: Important Criteria: The student correctly applies the index of refraction in the optical path difference equation.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student checks that the units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student fails to account for the correct sign in the optical path difference calculation.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student neglects to include the factor (n - 1) in the final equation for thickness.
